notes.title: Weekly Weather, UI Improvements, and Nervous Breakdowns!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I give you some news about improvement of the layer of realism and strategy to Full Metal Sergeant 2.

[h3]The weather[/h3]
Every in-game week, you’ll face different weather conditions that directly affect your training routines:

🌫️ Fog will make aiming at the shooting range more difficult.
☀️ Heat will drain your soldiers’ Stamina faster.
🌧️ Rain and Thunderstorms will increase Stress levels more quickly.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mkJJMnFz/meteo.png[/img]

Plan your week accordingly — and maybe don’t send your most exhausted recruits to the range during a heatwave!

[h3]Breakdowns[/h3]
at the start of each week, there’s a chance that one of your recruits might suffer a nervous breakdown.
You’ll be asked to pick one of three responses to help them snap out of it. Choose wisely — only one will motivate them to keep going!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wMrMN9VX/breakdowns.png[/img]

[h3]...and one more thing[/h3]
I’ve also improved the UI for training details.
Now, when you click on a training, you’ll see a cleaner, more readable panel with all the key stats and effects — so you can decide faster and more clearly where to send your soldiers.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mrSrwYj2/ui.png[/img]

That’s it for now — more updates coming soon as I continue shaping Full Metal Sergeant 2.
Thanks for all the support and feedback. You keep me going!

Carlo

notes.title: Unexpected Visitors at the Camp – Complete Their Tasks for Rewards!
notes.content:
Sergeants,

Strange visitors are arriving at the camp, each with their own requests. They’re not here for training – they have offers. Completing their tasks will grant valuable bonuses for your platoon. Let me introduce them:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/90qLzvn1/quest-arrival.gif[/img]

[h3]Special visitors[/h3]
🗿 The Relic Collector – He’s obsessed with war relics and will reward you if you find some. Maybe history has its own price…

🏥 The Field Doctor – Medical supplies are always scarce. Help him get extra resources, and he’ll make sure your platoon gets additional supplies for the next mission.

🔫 The Weapons Dealer – He’s looking for broken weapons from the battlefield. Bring him enough, and your platoon will have more ammo next time.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3xr2csF6/collector.png[/img]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
Every task comes with a reward, but is it worth it? Resources are limited, and every decision you make affects your platoon’s future. Will you trade supplies for potential advantages? Will you risk dealing with shady characters for better gear? Choose wisely.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SxZcFgZK/collector-rewards.png[/img]

Time to make some tough calls, Sergeant.
Carlo.

notes.title: Combat Power-Ups
notes.content:
Drill Sergeant,

It’s time to turn the tide of battle! I’m introducing Combat Power-Ups, temporary boosts that can give your squad the edge they need in the heat of the fight. These power-ups will enhance key aspects of your soldiers’ performance, making them deadlier, faster, and tougher when it matters most.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SR7Lt9b8/powerups.gif[/img]

Here’s some of them:

[list]
[*] Pills – Increases movement speed, letting your troops reposition faster.
[*] Machete – Boosts melee damage, turning your recruits into brutal close-combat fighters.
[*] Binoculars – Improves accuracy, making every shot count.
[*] Magazine – Adds more ammo for your rifle.
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3RZWsFWK/powerups-combat-ezgif-com-optimize.gif[/img]

Use them wisely—these boosts don’t last forever! Timing and strategy will be key to making the most out of them. I’m looking forward to seeing how you’ll incorporate them into your tactics.

Let me know what you think, and as always, keep pushing forward!

Dismissed!
Carlo

notes.title: A little taste of the new art
notes.content:
Hello aspiring sergeants,

Before talking about gameplay, I prefer to post this news by showing some of the new graphics. 


[h3]Portraits[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/WzxqqLRz/face-gif.gif[/img]
Each recruit now has their own unique portrait, adding an extra layer of immersion to the game. These portraits are randomly generated, ensuring a diverse range of appearances while also taking skin tone into account. Now, you’ll be able to connect with each recruit on a more personal level and finally look the worm in the face before punishing it.


[h3]New detailed animations[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wzhfd7sS/animations.gif[/img]
The animations of the recruits have been improved. Now there are more details, like eyes and expressions and more frames.


[h3]New sprites[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7ZkMK7c6/face-gif-Time-0-00-00-02.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mkmwbWQn/face-gif-Time-0-00-00-13.png[/img]
I’ve also added several new sprites to enrich the visual experience, particularly when you’re building up areas of the camp. Construction scenes now include a variety of construction objects and equipment to give a stronger sense of the work involved and to make each scene feel more dynamic and alive.


[h3]Good boy[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sX5rvwxy/dog.gif[/img]
...and for the dog lovers...don't worry he's still around and with upgraded visuals!


These changes are just the beginning, and I can’t wait for you to see what’s next. Thank you for your continued support!
Carlo.
